posts.name: Parthiv Kumar
posts.cooked:
I solved the first q within 5mins then got stuck with fibonacci question where i forgot to properly read input ,then with 20-25mins left I panicked and could not solve any more .

Also deeply regretted not going over the first oppe’s questions throughly ,at least could have gotten the sed q or known to read the input correctly .

posts.name: Madhav Rimal
posts.cooked:
yup ! , time plays an very important role for making situation worse ,

I was stuck with awk , just due to printf “%.4f$s”,

posts.name: Ritwik Chandra
posts.cooked:
I had also prepared for this exam from the sessions and the vm.But the level of the questions were too detailed.I dont know what is expected from us.Not a single question was matching from BPT and they had pretty complex subparts.
This is really frustating from a student point of view as the level of the questions must be maintained such that student are able to pass the oppe if not excel.

posts.name: Madhav Rimal
posts.cooked:
We have to grind more and aim for S grade now , no step back

In vacations i have planned this to get the comeback

  1. Making projects where i would use full power of bash automation and scripting
  2. Solving as much as possible leet questions
  3. Contributing to linux systems by making basic tools

posts.name: Vighnesh Sajeev
posts.cooked:
Just venting here as well.

After clearing everything else in SC last term but the OPPE, I was already doing repeat OPPE this term along with the 2 projects for my diploma, along with a grade improvement for PDSA to finish things off properly. Now I finished everything else needed for the programming diploma and now this term too I was unfortunate enough to not clear SC oppe again, so now I have no choice but to extend my diploma another term just to do SC again.

It’s so incredibly frustrating that right after my PDSA OPPE, which honestly felt much easier in hindsight, I spent literally the entire week practicing SC oppe practice questions and BPT questions and NPPE questions and even OPPE1 questions, just to not clear it again because re oppe was made a “tad bit trickier” than the first one for some reason, and two of my solutions pass all public test cases but not the private test cases that I cannot view anyway.

And now I have no choice but to extend finishing my diploma until December to take this course again and only study SC for the next 4 months and learn every single flag in man and hope that next time the first few approaches I take to solve questions will just so happen to align with the private test cases just so I can finally clear the requirements for this 3 credit course and finish this diploma and move onto the next one.

posts.cooked: Don’t don’t give up , we are with you , now make projects in vacations with bash you would be unstoppable

posts.name: Tamanna
posts.cooked: Same pain that I had chance to atleast go through oppe 1 ques and I didn’t thinking question would not be similar, but still it was very tricky. This is the first time I will repeat any course. Kindly share good resources for oppe so that we can fully utilize these vacation.

posts.name: Madhav Rimal
posts.cooked: I am repeating two now , for the first time in life a great lesson learnt in this journey

posts.name: Aayush Kotwani
posts.cooked: Can you share some good resources related to bash project and practise questions other than the one’s they provide that can help to clear oppe

posts.name: Madhav Rimal
posts.cooked:
Solve problems with bash , i mean solve problems which you face or you observed which you can solve, in up-coming vacations make projects where you use SC concepts into making file structures , automating script execution for your app , or making a data pre-processing pipeline made with bash capable of making required operations on textual , and other data types

Practice course material or go with leet code questions ,
